implementation: Online scalarized UCB adapted from bandits.ipynb; Eq. 43 initialization and Eqs. 46-48 scalarizer-specific statistics.

bandit.observation_bounds_note: Overhead bound is M times the largest float32 class policy size in KiB; instability bound is 1. These bounds normalize online observations only. Total-cost hypervolumes use reference_costs.
bandit.initialization_note: 100 online requests: 10 arms times 5 directions = 50 initialization requests, followed by 50 adaptive UCB requests. Each pull receives one online cost increment.

evaluation.note: Approximate the exponential set of all horizon-length sequences over the currently recommended arms using 16 sampled sequences and all constant sequences; deduplicate. Reuse identical held-out scenario seeds and Sobol draws across subsets, formulations, and gravity levels. Cache repeated subsets. Evaluation observations never update the bandit.
evaluation.hypervolume_note: Empirical RTS/STR polar hypervolume of the sampled sequence set, using the same fixed total-cost reference as MORBO/qNParEGO. Plot current estimates, without a cumulative maximum.

horizon_note: UCB trains for 100 global requests. Held-out sequences have length 100, matching this approach in MORBO/qNParEGO. Online training and held-out evaluation are separate budgets.
